mapper.select: select kbd.id, kbd.file_id, kbd.knowledge_base_id, df.file_name, df.file_size, df.sha256, df.status, kbd.created_at from knowledge_base_document kbd join document_file df on df.id = kbd.file_id where kbd.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} and df.user_id = #{userId} order by kbd.created_at desc
